themes.name: School Learning and Support
themes.rule: Proposals for K–12 school facilities, staffing, class instruction, academic help, or student meals belong here.

themes.name: Arts, Culture, and Libraries
themes.rule: Proposals that expand access to public art, cultural events, arts instruction, museums, or library branches belong here.

themes.name: Affordable Housing
themes.rule: Proposals that create, preserve, regulate, compare prices for, or improve the energy performance of housing and student accommodation belong here.

themes.name: Waste Reduction and Recycling
themes.rule: Proposals concerning household waste collection, recycling, composting, or reducing disposable materials belong here.

themes.name: Digital City Access
themes.rule: Proposals that provide digital connectivity, online government transactions, digital city information, or help using online city services belong here.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Small Business
themes.rule: Proposals that support workers’ career transitions, local hiring, coworking, small-business finance, or business licensing belong here.

themes.name: Public Transit Service
themes.rule: Proposals that improve bus or other public-transit fares, frequency, operating hours, or rider information belong here.

themes.name: Safe Streets and Cycling
themes.rule: Proposals that make streets safer for pedestrians and cyclists through traffic calming, protected cycling infrastructure, or street lighting belong here.

themes.name: Parks and Neighborhood Green Space
themes.rule: Proposals for parks, playgrounds, gardens, street trees, or dog recreation areas belong here.

themes.name: Healthcare and Prevention
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical care, mental-health services, in-home care, specialist access, or disease screening belong here.

themes.name: Emergency and Crime Response
themes.rule: Proposals for emergency-response capacity, police neighborhood presence, or surveillance at crime locations belong here.

themes.name: Clean Air and Municipal Energy
themes.rule: Proposals that monitor air pollution or reduce municipal energy emissions through renewable power belong here.
